description: A frameset HTML file used in a CKEditor plugin, responsible for dynamically loading scripts, configuring frame sizes, and establishing a frameset layout for a web-based interface.

methods.name: doLoadScript
methods.description: Dynamically loads an external JavaScript file into the document by creating and appending a script element to the document head.

methods.name: tryLoad
methods.description: Initializes the frameset layout by retrieving parameters from the opener window, setting the rows configuration dynamically, and loading a script specified by the configuration.
